cadence.note: Quality first: 2–3 high-quality documentaries per week (replaces the earlier 20-per-month target).

extended_when: detailed storytelling the argument depends on
duration_minutes.rule: Length follows the story: never pad with filler, repeated points, slow holds or recap to reach a target.

production.opening: Open on a powerful hook in the first seconds; no logo intro or title card.
production.reuse_policy: Reuse kit components (characters, sets, vault, helpers) but re-stage them: new compositions, camera moves, palettes accents and metaphors per episode; no two consecutive scenes share a primary subject, and no episode repeats a previous episode's hero shot.
production.cost_policy: Free local tools only: no paid external APIs; avoid unnecessary AI usage (snapshots before renders, cached scene renders, no speculative full re-renders).

quality_standard.semantic_sync: visuals start on the Whisper time of the word that names them (±0.3 s); camera moves start ~1 s before
quality_standard.no_repeat: a reused world/set must change at least two of environment, perspective, action, purpose
quality_standard.motion_review: render and watch a 540p motion sample of each priority sequence before approval
requirements: professional visual design and environmental detail
semantic visual storytelling that explains meaning, mechanism, cause or consequence
quality_standard.scene_brief: message, audience understanding, demonstrating actions, trigger words, cause→mechanism→consequence — written before building
quality_standard.continuation_rule: introducing an object does not complete the explanation: each company/facility gets introduction → operation → transaction
quality_standard.not_evidence: frame-change metrics, camera movement, glow and particles are not evidence of quality

captions.engine_note: remotion = approved pilot path (separate burn pass). hyperframes = kit/captions.py, same look, no extra pass — switch after approval.

1440p.status: optional — not the default until benchmarked on a real episode
1440p.how: render.py render WS -o OUT --resolution 1440p (separate cache keys; compositions stay authored at 1920x1080 and are rasterised at 2560x1440)
1440p.captions: use captions.engine = hyperframes (rendered with the frames); the Remotion burn pass has not been validated at 1440p

render.final_quality_note: HyperFrames 'looks' = H.264 CRF 16, yuv420p tv-range — the approved pilot setting
